# Tendril — AI-assisted development context (Strands fallback)

> Tendril is an AWS Strands multi-agent reference implementation: a domain-agnostic,
> config-driven agent framework (tools-as-APIs, agents from a factory, model-driven
> orchestration, externalized prompts + guardrails) with a garden-assistant application.
> This file is the **fallback context** for AI coding assistants when the Strands Agents
> MCP docs server (`.mcp.json`) is unavailable. Primary mechanism is the MCP server;
> these links point at authoritative, always-current Strands docs in raw markdown.

## Strands Agents (authoritative docs)

- [Strands docs index (llms.txt)](https://strandsagents.com/llms.txt): index of all docs pages in raw markdown.
- [Strands full docs (llms-full.txt)](https://strandsagents.com/llms-full.txt): complete documentation in one file (excludes API reference).
- [Build with AI](https://strandsagents.com/docs/user-guide/build-with-ai/): how to ground AI assistants on Strands (MCP server + llms.txt).
- [Python quickstart](https://strandsagents.com/docs/user-guide/quickstart/): minimal agent loop.
- Tip: append `/index.md` to any docs page URL to get its raw markdown.

## Read first (this repo)

- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): binding AI-development rules; ADRs as guardrails; hard rules.
- [Project concept & vision](./docs/project-context.md): the two-layer framework + application.
- [Architecture](./docs/architecture/architecture.md).
- [Decisions (ADRs)](./docs/architecture/ADRs/): binding architectural constraints (0001–0008).
- [Engineering best practices](./docs/engineering-best-practices.md): standards + Definition of Done.
- [Backlog](./docs/backlog.md) and [stories](./docs/stories/): what to build, in priority order.

## Governance

- ADRs are binding. Request an ADR before any architecturally significant change — never assume one.
- No hardcoded secrets/account IDs; env + CDK context + SSM/Secrets Manager; IAM roles, not keys.
